personality: 3 Editorial Mobile structure with 4 Tactile / Playful bento-grid surfaces and organic SVG geometry
personality_one_liner: A digital editorial lifestyle companion featuring expressive minimalism, organic bento grids, and pastel warmth without toxic positivity. 'Un día a la vez, a tu modo.'

spacing.rule: Bento grid rhythm with open sections. Avoid exaggerated vertical spaces. Use margins of 16-20px laterally.

dont's: No glassmorphism, no generic gradients, no neon, no heavy shadows. The aesthetic relies on flat pastel shapes and paper-like textures.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user explicitly requested specific typography weights. IGNORE the standard '500 max' rule. Use Plus Jakarta Sans 700-800 for main titles (30-36px), 700 for section titles (22-26px), 600-700 for cards (17-20px), and 600 for buttons.
Do NOT use ALL CAPS anywhere. Follow sentence case strictly.

Build the layout as a Bento Grid. Use the pastel tokens (`lavender`, `sage`, `coral`, `sky`, `butter`) directly as `backgroundColor` on the cards. Do not use generic thin borders around cards; let the solid pastel backgrounds define the bento structure over the `surfaceSecondary` (#F7F6F2) canvas.
Bottom Tab Bar styling: Must be dark ink (`#25282A`) background. Icons and selection indicators must be light/white. Labels must always be visible. No glassmorphism.
Mood Check-in: DO NOT use standard emojis. Implement custom SVG shapes (react-native-svg) using imperfect circles and soft geometric forms with minimal expressions (eyes/lines).
Color Semantic Mapping: Lavender = Agenda/Planning, Sage/Green = Support/Wellbeing, Coral/Peach = Comfort/Care, Sky/Blue = Organization, Butter/Yellow = Identity/Entertainment.
Micro-interactions: Ensure Reanimated transitions are brief (150-250ms). Use simple scaling (0.97 press) and fast fade-ins. Respect reduced motion if applicable.
Images for Kits: Must maintain an editorial, lifestyle look. Do not treat it as an e-commerce marketplace.
Accessibility: Ensure all touch targets are at least 44x44. Text must not truncate unexpectedly.
